description: Source code for a Type 1 font parser in the FreeType project, handling font file reading, format checking, and private dictionary extraction.

methods.name: read_pfb_tag
methods.description: Reads a segment tag and size from a PFB font stream.

methods.name: check_type1_format
methods.description: Checks if the font stream matches a Type 1 font header.

methods.name: T1_New_Parser
methods.description: Initializes a new Type 1 font parser, setting up dictionaries and format detection.

methods.name: T1_Finalize_Parser
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the parser.

methods.name: T1_Get_Private_Dict
methods.description: Extracts the private dictionary from a font stream, handling both PFB and PFA formats.
